body.message:
Before confirming my booking, I would like to clarify one important point based on my previous experience.
Could you please ensure that the apartment, especially the kitchen, is thoroughly cleaned and free from any cleanliness issues? During my last stay elsewhere, I experienced some problems with the kitchen, and I would like to avoid a similar situation.
This is my annual vacation, which I have been planning for almost a year, so I sincerely hope the apartment meets a high standard of cleanliness, maintenance, and overall presentation, as shown in the listing.
I appreciate your understanding and look forward to your confirmation. Thank you!
body.contact_name: Mrs Dalal Ali Jumah Khamis Alshehhi
